ops.title: Phase 1 — the graph builder (internal/kg), zero LLM
ops.description:
Nodes: 8 entity kinds (free — `EntityID` is the root commit oid, content-addressed, so duplicate entities cannot exist and Graphiti's entire entity-resolution stage is deleted); path/dir/commit/branch from the 4 `AnchorKind`s; session from `CC_NOTES_SESSION_ID`; concept from Phase 6's local NER.

Edges: declared (`AddDep`, `SetParent`, `SetSprint`, `SetProject`, `AddFollowUp`, `LinkCommit`, `AddFixCommit`), anchoring, supersede, containment, co-change (`git log --numstat` at anchor granularity, Code Maat's revisions + entity-churn), co-occurrence.

Two derivations earn their place because of the sparsity finding: synthesize path anchors for tasks from their `Commits []SHA` (the planning layer is otherwise disconnected from code — mark it as derived so it can be down-weighted), and treat shared-session as an edge.

Reuse rather than rebuild — the episodic layer is already built: `fold.History(commits)` → `trail.Entries` yields a per-commit `(entity, field, from→to, actor, session, lamport, time)` stream; `viz.classify` already turns those into a 16-verb lifecycle vocabulary; `viz.EntitySummary` is already a flat cross-kind graph-ready node record.

**Symbol nodes: cut, and the reason is not cost.** cc-context computes callers/callees on demand with no persistent call graph and no centrality anywhere, so there is nothing to reuse; building one means adopting 23 tree-sitter WASM grammars plus a zig toolchain for a corpus whose facts anchor at file granularity. Not one monorepo note anchors below a path.

Storage: bbolt (already an indirect dep via daemonkit/fusekit) under `~/.cc-notes/repos/<key16>/graph-v1` and `embed-v1`. Fold-cache discipline: content-addressed keys so a present entry is always valid, rename-atomic writes, every I/O error a miss that never propagates.

Sync split — the answer is not "index or no index": derived-and-cheap (adjacency, vectors, lexical index, PPR scores, queue) never syncs and never enters the git dir; derived-and-expensive (LLM conclusions, triplets, salience, supersede proposals) syncs as **first-class cc-notes ops on existing entities**, where it inherits CRDT merge, provenance, supersede and history for free. No new sync surface to merge.

ops.text: A full rebuild over ~/Code/monorepo's real refs completes in under 5 s and the store is under 10 MB
Node and edge counts by kind are reported by cc-notes kg stat
No derived index is written to refs/cc-notes/* or into the git dir
